notes.title: SPRYDITE Open World
notes.content:
Hello! Alongside working on the mechanics, special attention is given to the aspects of the game's open world. This open world is quite extensive, spanning several tens of square kilometers. Players will have access to the entire peninsula, where they can explore and survive.
